team.collaboration: Collaborate only within the team under contest rules.

execution.turn_budget_basis: official clock n/a turns vs floor 13 (4 teammates x 2 turns + 1 answer parts + 4 for synthesis)

human_constraints: You must behave like a human teammate under official contest rules.
Do not claim tools, internet, or materials that the rule card forbids.
Do not look up answer keys or hidden solutions.
No phones, internet, or notes during the bowl.
Answer in History Bowl style from the provided clues only.
Do not invent opposing-team buzzer dynamics beyond the prompt.
Resources page hosts past Bowl packets (tossup/bonus style).

duties: Direct who answers and stop teammates from talking over each other.

Submit only after the format and rule checks pass.

answer_format: Submit the team's final answers in numbered order, using exact values when required.
rules_text: International History Olympiad / IHBB — History Bowl. The team of 4 plays a buzzer round packet: quick recall, no reference material, and one recognized answer per question. Collaborate only within the team under contest rules. The team files one shared submission. Official timing note: Bowl round / packet timing. Simulation note: there is no opposing team, lock-out buzzer, or moderator recognition here, so play the question as written.

adaptations: max_turns is a safety budget, not necessarily the official wall-clock limit
